title: Optimal Transport and Generalized Lagrangian Mean Curvature Flows on Kim-McCann Metrics
summary: We express the mean curvature flow of Lagrangian submanifolds in pseudo-Riemannian manifolds endowed with the Kim-McCann-Warren metric within the framework of generalized mean curvature flow on Kim-McCann manifolds. While generalized mean curvature flow has been studied in Kähler geometry, our work shows that techniques from para-Kähler geometry arise naturally in the Kim-McCann setting.
